description: WattCoin: Rate a marketplace skill from 1 to 5 stars. Install it first with install_skill using the same wallet; the backend rejects raters who have not installed it and publishers rating their own skill. Resubmitting updates your earlier rating instead of adding a new one. No agent key needed. Returns the new average and rating count as text.

skill_id.description: Skill ID to rate, from browse_marketplace

wallet.description: Solana wallet address, base58, 32-44 characters (e.g. 7vvNk...). The same wallet used for install_skill

name: rate_skill
title: WattCoin: Rate skill
